description.value: This Walmart Supercenter in Penticton is one of the largest retail and grocery destinations in the South Okanagan, stocking a full range of food, household goods, electronics, and clothing under one roof. An on-site pharmacy (confirmed via OSM) adds a practical stop for touring cyclists needing first-aid supplies or medications. Its location on Green Avenue West makes it a convenient resupply point for riders passing through the Penticton corridor.
